reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: mint_ctokens has a non-test caller at market.move:285. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is user-facing deposit (untrusted). Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via the deposit entry point by calling it with a collateral_amount less than the current exchange_rate in raw token units, causing mint_amount=0 to be computed and the deposited coin to be permanently consumed with 0 cTokens returned, resulting in direct fund loss to the depositor.
